install: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -q libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libgtk-3-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev build-essential libssl-dev libasound2-dev lsof && curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --no-modify-path && (cd /tmp && git config --global user.email 'verify@xnaut.local' && git config --global user.name 'xNAUT Verify') && npm ci && (npx playwright install --with-deps chromium || npx playwright install chromium)
test: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin xnaut && npx playwright test
